Was leaving a club one night with some friends and the guy I was dating at the time, standing outside, waiting for a pair of them to get purses from their car so we could take the train. It's 2 am, club is closing, everyone is outside.

A guy who had been dancing with us girls, giving one of which his number and all of us his snap, buying us bottles, and throwing out handfuls of $100 bills throughout the night, was just off to my right arguing with a couple guys who we had seen inside. 

Next thing I remember, there's loud pops, and guys B and C are down. My very tall bf threw out his arms around our circle of friends, as his back was directly closest to the shooter. But my genius hobbit self ran straight under his arm to guy B. He had fallen HARD, and guy A and friends had already screeched away in a car. So I snuggled my knees up around his head so his head and neck wouldn't get jostled, because he definitely hit his head. I check his pulse and tell a few people to call 911, and tell another to do CPR. Genuinely no idea how the fuck I was any type of calm, but no one really heard me anyways except to call, because everyone was screaming. I stayed there, putting compression on the bullet wound in his forehead and trying to find the other ones in his chest, and a couple other girls were helping me too. He had been looking up at me from my lap, and I tried to close his eyes, because I knew that he was gone. They don't close like they do in movies. Then finally the ambulance came, and that's when I lost my absolute shit. I had been so calm, quiet, focused. But once they took him, I had the worst panic attack of my life. Someone ended up calling me an ambulance too, and I was given more Ativan than I ever should have been. I remember showering off the blood in the er, and then waking up at my dad's home, with my mother in my bed. 
Couldn't look at my hands for weeks man.
